reviews.text: A truly excellent and warm-hearted veterinary clinic from the perspective of a recent animal lover and clearly not seeking to raise funds. I hope it remains independent and does not end up in a chain of private investment companies.
Great professional service, and reasonably priced.

The best veterinary station in the entire capital region. I highly recommend it.
Professional staff cares with a big heart
Great, knowledgeable vet and also relatively affordable. No rush and they know how to handle animals. Nice place, will definitely come again!
Good and affordable vet. Strong recommendation👍
A reasonably priced clinic that does not compromise on the level of expertise.
A good and knowledgeable veterinarian.

Rude service. I called with a cry in my throat about my cat's sore throat, which was found the night before. The next day, they recommended calling this place because they no longer had appointments. I called customer service. I explained the situation to the customer service representative, to which he replied rudely "it doesn't sound acute, treat it on Monday at least at Sopulitie". I added that the cat hasn't eaten well and is really grumpy. To this he simply stated that there are no appointments. We went to the animal hospital to take care of the matter, where it was determined that the cat had an acute abscess infection and a very painful one. There, the veterinarian immediately stated that it needed to be treated today.
Really cruel customer service when the biggest emergency is a member of your own family. At least it's not worth calling here for urgent matters, if at all. No more. If you want ugly service, this is the place.

The place is nice, the vet was kind while visiting there. but the issue is that everytime i try to call them - no one answers or if they do, they hang up after a minute when i ask to speak english. Very rude. The other thing is we asked a follow up with a vet regarding a treatment that has been given, and the vet instead of calling - just sent me an sms message. Which left me without any space to ask anything.

Very professional and sensitive work towards the dog. A fearful and aggressive rescue dog received excellent care. We became regular customers. The adjacent parking spaces were also a big plus when carrying a heavy dog ​​to the car.

We have had bad experiences with Herta. Our 13-year-old dog had two expensive dental surgeries there. After the surgeries, his condition deteriorated rapidly. He started peeing inside and we could clearly see that he was no longer doing well. With a heavy heart, we had to have him euthanized, for which we received a measly 30 euro discount. However, these treatments cost 1222 euros in total. We sent a complaint and asked for part of the costs to be reimbursed. They did not reimburse at all, because it was not a medical error.
We had a similar experience with our 12-year-old dog at Malmi Apex in 2020. They reimbursed us half of the money we paid.

You can't buy products from the place because there are almost never any customer service representatives there. This has happened to me several times, sometimes I've waited 30 minutes. This time they just angrily yelled that the products aren't for sale because there are no staff. So apparently you shouldn't have even asked about it. There should be information about this on the website or even a sign at the counter.

A wonderful and warm clinic. I was able to book an appointment for the same day and at a normal price even though it was a Saturday! The attending veterinarian, Anne Lipiäinen, was brilliant and very customer service oriented. I highly recommend it!

They claimed to have called, but that's not what's in the call records. They then sent an email informing them that the cat had a bacterial infection that required a course of antibiotics. The email had gone to spam. I think it's such an urgent matter that they'll call until the owner is reached. Or they'll even send a text message. For these reasons, the start of the AB course was delayed by several days (which also had availability problems). The results of the blood tests had to be requested separately. Other results are not automatically told/given, but you have to ask for them yourself. I'm still waiting for a response to my email on Friday.
Based on the calls and visits, it's a very busy clinic, communication doesn't work and/or there are too few staff.

Thank you Hanna and Herta's staff for the best possible care <3 Hanna always meets patients and owners with exceptional warmth and kindness, and treats the fur-eared cats with great and solid professionalism in small and big concerns. I couldn't ask for anything more <3 Warmest recommendation!
<3 Sari, Nahla and Halia

Veterinary clinic refuses to treat entrepreneur's dog due to ownership relationship
Veterinary clinic Hertta refused to take Tarja Malmström's dog for treatment. According to the call recording, the clinic directly stated that the dog would not be treated because Malmström owns a company called Sinun Lemmikkisi Oy.
In the call, a representative of the clinic stated that the clinic would not accept the dog as a client for that reason.
The reporter confirmed the matter by calling the clinic. The clinic maintained its position.
Malmström has recently been acquitted in a criminal case concerning his business activities. The Pirkanmaa District Court dismissed all charges.
The case raises questions about the basis on which a veterinary clinic can limit clients and whether the refusal of service can be based on the entrepreneur's ownership relationship.
Veterinary clinic Hertta has been asked for a comment on the matter.
Nice clinics, good attitude!

Hertta is simply the best! We now live in Espoo, but we still go to Hertta with our dogs because the care is just so good. Lovely and friendly caregivers, dog-oriented and professional doctors. The prices are also ok, and you can get care for the same price in the evenings and weekends. Special thanks to Hanna Dyggve - my shy dog ​​begs Hanna for scratches, which she wouldn't do to anyone, especially not to doctors. Hanna also keeps the owner wonderfully informed about where to go and what examinations and procedures are worth doing.
The cat received good care!
We called in the morning and got an appointment for the same day. Really nice staff!
Nothing bad to say. We will use all the dogs in the household if possible now and in the future. Expert service, friendly staff and people who are genuinely interested in the well-being of the pet.

With many years of experience, I have already had dental calculus removal done by Jonna, great care! Now our dog had a hysterectomy on 10.10 in the afternoon. The nurse stayed even though it was time to go home, thank you!! Doctor Katrin is absolutely wonderful!! You can barely see the surgical wound, great job! Thank you for saving our dog! You are the best!
Nice and professional staff. Reasonable prices. Great service.
The best care for your pet.
It's not worth calling here, at least not for urgent matters, if at all. I called nine times in the middle of the day over a two-hour period and no one answered. Apparently too few staff.

Best of all, the same prices in the evenings and on weekends as during the day on weekdays. Evening hours are often available. It's just really hard to get anyone on the phone on the weekends, but understandable if only vets are working then. Maybe a bit old-fashioned reception rooms, but still functional.
friendly,good hospitality,but expensive

The only vet in Helsinki area where I never felt rushed. Where they take their time to listen to you, where the appointments are long enough to have time to explain the issue and where the prices are normal, not a rip off like in many other vet clinics. Many thanks to doctor Hannu Ropponen!

We went for the puppy's first vaccinations and it went really well👍🏻 Hanna was absolutely great and gave the vaccinations on the floor with the puppy in her arms, the guy didn't even realize anything🩷 we'll definitely be coming here again at 16 weeks. …

We had our cat treated here on a Saturday morning. We had to treat our cat on a very busy day. The staff at the clinic treated the cat kindly and took our busy schedule into account. We are grateful for the good care and the clinic's ability to be flexible due to the client's schedule.

Perfect service when taking my dog ​​for dental care.
And the price for the entire procedure was very reasonable/reasonable in my opinion, positively surprised.

Friendly and professional staff. Years of experience in using the clinic and the service has always been on point. Procedures are animal-specific, with expert guidance and instructions for home care. Special dog food for cats and dogs can be found on the shelf on site.

Thank you very much for the very good care and warm welcome. However, life does not always go as you wish. You greeted me very warmly and gave me time to say goodbye to a family member. Thank you very much❤️

But nevertheless, it's a decent place with delicious food, friendly service, and a pleasant and clean atmosphere. It's perfect for meeting friends/colleagues or for a romantic evening for two. The prices are reasonable. I've been to Lounas a couple of times, and everything is also good.
